def corner_sequences(arr, cells, bg):

 corners=[('TL',r0,c0,1,1),('TR',r0,c1,1,-1),('BL',r1,c0,-1,1),('BR',r1,c1,-1,-1)]
 res=[]
 for name,rr,cc,dr,dc in corners:
  diag=[]
  for t in range(min(r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1)):
   v=int(arr[rr+dr*t,cc+dc*t])
   if v==bg:
    if t==0: diag.append(v);continue
    break

def gen_anycorner(arr,div,bg,mode='morph'):
 R,C=arr.shape; seen=set(); out=arr.copy(); infos=[]
